ETag.description: Strong validator of this representation (quoted hex of its SHA-256 prefix). It changes whenever the served read changes: a new content revision, a price version bump, a listing flip or a category rename.

Cache-Control.description: Freshness window every read may be cached for (CDN-friendly).

304.description: The If-None-Match value still matches; no body is sent.

400.description: invalid-limit, invalid-cursor, unknown-query-parameter (search only) or malformed-request (a NUL in the query string of any route).

404.description: not-found (no such product, a stub row, or an id longer than 128 characters) or resource-not-found (a NUL in the request path, on any route).

500.description: internal-error; the detail never carries the internal message.
